ns2:course.label: Museum Theory and Practice
ns2:course.description: (ANTH 391) Course uses campus museums to introduce students to research on collections, conservation, collections management, exhibit design and installation, public relations, and planning educational programs. Emphasis varies from year to year. Students participate in current research projects at the museums. Same as LA 572. May be repeated to a maximum of 8 hours. Prerequisite: ANTH 314 and ANTH 315 or consent of instructor.
